Hi Laura,

I've been thinking about our move and how we can make our new place feel more intuitive. I found a group that can help us harmonize the house's rhythm with our own habits. Since we are moving into a brand-new build, we can use a special bypass to {{1}}, and if we commit before the 20th of September, they'll even throw in a specialized tool to monitor the very air we breathe.

I'm leaning toward the highest tier because it doesn't just watch the doors; it actually manages the heavy machinery in the laundry room to {{2}}. It's about $95 every month, but considering they claim we can {{3}}, it basically pays for itself. I love the idea of you being able to check the cameras from your phone while you're traveling, and having the house {{4}} without us lifting a finger.

I know we have some of our own gadgets already, but the "Upgrade" path seems less useful for us since we want a {{5}}. Let me know if you think the full suite is worth it, or if we should just start with the entry-point hub and grow from there.

Love,
Daniel
